notes.title: Please welcome the Jo-Shi Sisters!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540494/d3027d1ba434cf30aa2121c1dd2242daa0ef006f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540494/82e3a14df5a097918c2a1b38628a7d0f7b5c55d4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Meet Joanna Vasile and Stakushi Yumemori! You can now meet these two not-actually-related-sisters in the Labyrinth with their boss fight in the new demo, only available for a limited time! [/p][p]While traversing the Labyrinth, Ayana stumbles upon these 2 spectacularly well-dressed vampires hanging out in an abandoned chapel. And of course, everything and [i]everyone [/i]wants to immediately fight her. Watch out though, these spunky sisters pack a real punch![/p][p]This boss fight was actually an on-ground exclusive at gamescom, and so far, less than 20 people have beaten the sisters! Will you add to those numbers? Or fall to the sisters like the hundreds before you?[/p]

notes.title: Something is coming... Stay tuned!
notes.content: [p]We're working on a bunch of things for Bloodbreaker, including: bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and... a BIG new update, coming very soon! We' can't wait to hear your thoughts and reactions on it, but until then, we're still working on polishing and optimizing the game so that you'll have the best experience when the new update drops![/p]

notes.title: We're a part of the Southeast Asian Games Showcase!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540494/20ea35654b1a99a1bbc6a604705888c340cee267.png"][/img][/p][p]A big thanks to the Southeast Asian Games Showcase for featuring us in the showcase and Steam event! We're keeping our demo up for just a bit more, try it out, and leave a review/comment if you have any feedback or suggestions! [/p][p][/p][p]We have exciting plans ahead for Bloodbreaker, including some events where we're hoping to get first-impression reviews from players! [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for the support, we'll keep working on the game to make it a great experience for fans of the genre![/p]

notes.title: We hit 3000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
We just hit [b]3,000[/b] wishlists recently on Steam! We only announced the project [i]officially[/i] a month or so ago, and even if we're still super early in development, we're so happy to see the support for the game so far!

We recently debuted the first public demo at PAX East in May, and we've heard so many nice things from attendees, as well as some feedback (which we are working on!). Here's to more events where we can chat with you guys and get people's reactions and feedback!

We hope 3,000 wishlists is just the first of many milestones we will reach with Bloodbreaker, we're so excited to be working on this game, and bringing it to life. We'll leave the demo up on Steam for a bit, and if you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to leave a review, or post in the community hub.

The Labyrinth Awaits!
